variants.title: Proportional counter: resolution at the Np L X-rays of Am-241
variants.sample: Am-241 source (neptunium L-alpha 13.95 keV and L-beta 17.61 keV X-rays)
variants.unknown: the energy resolution of the counter at 13.95 keV
variants.note: The 59.5 keV gamma rays mostly pass through the thin gas layer; the counter sees the L X-rays of the neptunium daughter. The resolution improves as 1/sqrt(E). Line energies and the L-beta / L-alpha ratio of about 1.4 are from memory - verify.
